response.overview: Tuesday night at the Arena at Harbor Yard in Bridgeport, it was a totally different story. Two months on the road has the musicians playing much tighter and singer Roger Daltrey back in form as one of the top rock roarers out there.  To use another sports analogy, Daltrey reached back for a few of the miles that he seemed to have lost off his fastball during the New York City concert and, quite frankly, The Who's latest album, Endless Wire.  There's just a spark he adds to the band when he's on and that was evident Tuesday night during blistering versions of "Baba O'Riley" and, most telling, "Won't Get Fooled Again." The famous yell near the end of "Fooled"? He nailed it, much to the delight of the sell-out crowd of around 10,000 in the sweltering venue.
response.title: The Who: Bridgeport 11/28/2006
